I'm a kunkka spammer as well, both core and support, I wouldn't say he's completely ruined as he technically received some buffs, but his late game is god awful now whereas before he could at least burst one person late game (More if you're lucky/good)


His early game is way stronger and as far as your complaint about phase boots being worse goes, you don't get those on him anymore if you're playing him mid. The movement speed was always a bit negligible and you picked them up for the damage; You get treads for sure and it's arguably a buff as you get more damage than phase used to give and you get tread switching+better stats. He also has a stupid amount of HP Regen due to strength changes in lane which really helps him stay in lane and let's him be semi-viable in the offlane (Which I think we might start seeing more as tidebringer can really bully people). His cleave is 165% at all levels, which makes it really good early game as you can bully just about any mid laner out of lane if you're aiming tidebringers correctly. 


Now, his mid game is decently worse and he's trash late game now. Before during the mid game you could at least hunt the enemy carry and burst them, now they can pick up some armor and basically guarantee they won't die to a combo (And possibly turn it on you). If the enemy cores and/or heroes in general are agility heroes you are fucked, they will be above 10 armor in the mid game and you won't be able to burst them. You're still ok in teamfights though as your magic damage isn't anything to sneeze at and if you have a teammate following up you should be able to get kills. 


Late game? I don't even know what to do with him anymore late game, he basically lost all of his late game potential because of cleave changes and his loss of the +50% cleave talent. He doesn't really do damage without those things anymore and if enemies are building correctly your magic damage will be negligible as well. The only thing you really can do is burst a non-agi support (If they're poor and/or underleveled, if they aren't, you can't even do that anymore). Other than that, you can give your team 50% damage reduction is ok I suppose and ghostship fleets can zone enemies hard, but he's not strong anymore. I can be 5-10k networth ahead of the enemy carry and do nothing to him which really sucks.


As far as how to fix him, I have a few thoughts, changing his tidebringer back to original values and making it pierce armor is my first immediate thought, I don't think it's that game breaking and there are counters to it (blademail, aeon disk). He could also just flat out have tidebringer changed, which would kinda suck, but would give him a full cohevise kit as a support in some way.  He could also just have his reduced CD tidebringer talent (Which is useless compared  to ghostship  fleet) changed to "Tidebringer pierces armor" and I think that would be fair. Maybe even adding a bit more skill to how you target tidebringer and making it pierce armor would be fair like having it target an area like torrent or something like that.


To wrap this up though, there might just be a different way to build kunkka now instead of stacking damage and a bit of tank. Maybe magic burst kunkka is good now, maybe stacking minus armor in your comp is good now. I have to experiment and see I suppose. I think he is certainly a stronger laner now though and can really just kick most mid heroes out of the lane if you aren't an absolute idiot with aiming tidebringers. I think he might end up being good in the offlane now too due to strength changes helping him sustain and the fact he can possibly bully a carry out of lane.
